    → Move them into the railsConfig callback in rspack.config.mjs

    → Run `bin/rails rspack:install`
✓ Entry points: application

    → Run `bin/rails rspack:build` (only needed without the dev server)
! Layout: application.html.erb still includes javascript_importmap_tags
    → Remove it if rspack replaces importmap, or the app may load JavaScript twice

    → Use stylesheet_link_tag "application" (or list your own stylesheets); a print or admin bundle otherwise applies on every page

    → Use `js: npm run dev` for HMR

    → Re-run `bin/rails rspack:install:tailwind`, which adds `@source not` lines to app/javascript/application.css

    → Re-run `bin/rails rspack:install`
